name: @sylphx/flux-wasm
description: FLUX v2 WebAssembly bindings — consumer artifact for @sylphx/flux

scripts.build: wasm-pack build ../../crates/flux-wasm --target web --out-dir ./wasm --out-name flux_wasm && rm -f ./wasm/.gitignore && test -s ./wasm/flux_wasm_bg.wasm
